text: {"assertions":["A 401 authentication storm issue was discovered in services/auth/token_refresh.py when access tokens expired mid-session.","The 401 storm manifested as bursts of unauthorized responses in the access log on the staging read replica.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated when data was written.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction as part of PR #3464 on branch fix/401-storm-1.","After deploying the fix, the error backlog cleared within 62 minutes.","The authentication service is built in Python.","The token refresh issue is covered by tests in tests/auth/test_token_refresh.py."]}
